κατα-πίπτω

elsewhere.note: Other seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.
When we had all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew language, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me? It is hard for you to kick…
